datamap-ve-experimental: Tifaftiraha muuqaalka khariidadda wali waa tijaabo
datamap-ve-experimental-content:
Waxaad ka bixi kartaa wakhti kasta adigoo adeegsanaya dookhyada isticmaalaha ee MediaWiki qaybta Tafatirka.

Ogow in qaar ka mid ah hawlaha laga yaabo inaan la heli karin, khaladaadna ay dhici karaan - si aad u aragto liiska khaladaadka ama aad u gudbiso warbixin, booqo arrinta #149 ee kaydka DataMaps GitHub.
datamap-userpref-enable-ve: Awood geli tifaftiraha muuqaalka ee khariidadaha xogta marka uu xasilloon noqdo
datamap-userpref-enable-ve-beta: Igu dar tijaabooyinka tifaftiraha muuqaalka khariidadda
datamap-ve-beta-notice: Tifaftirahan muuqaalka ah wuxuu ku jiraa marxalad hore oo horumarineed. Fadlan ku soo gudbi khaladaadka GitHub.
datamap-ve-limited-preview-notice: Qaar ka mid ah astaamaha lama heli karo marka khariidadda lagu sii eegayo tifaftiraha muuqaalka.
tag-datamaps-visualeditor-description: Tafatir lagu sameeyey iyadoo la adeegsanayo tifaftiraha muuqaalka DataMaps
datamap-ve-field-locked-unknown-value: Astaantan waxaa loo dejiyey qiime aanu hadda taageerin tifaftirahan muuqaalka ah. Tifaftiraha koodhka isha ayaa loo baahan yahay si wax looga beddelo.
datamap-ve-panel-msettings-set-view-desc: Dejintan waxay saameeyaan oo keliya khibradda daawashada. Hadda, qaar ka mid ah ma taageero tifaftiraha muuqaalka.
datamap-ve-panel-msettings-field-legend: Qari sharraxaadda khariidadda iyo kontaroolada muuqaalka
datamap-ve-panel-msettings-field-sortche: Kala soocidda liiska hubinta waxyaabaha la ururin karo
Marka loo eego tirada calaamadaha la taxay
datamap-ve-panel-msettings-field-coordin: Ku muuji isku duwayaasha geeska hoose ee bidix
datamap-ve-panel-msettings-field-allowfu: Muuji badhan lagu geli karo shaashad buuxda
datamap-ve-panel-msettings-field-popupbe: U muuji sida tilmaame yar (marka jiirka korkiisa la dul maro)
datamap-ve-panel-msettings-field-require: U baahan aqoonsiyada calaamadaha ee si cad loo cayimay

Aqoonsiyada calaamadaha waxaa loo isticmaalaa xiriirrada joogtada ah ee calaamadaha iyo astaanta waxyaabaha la ururin karo. Sida caadiga ah, aqoonsiyada waxaa si toos ah loo abuuraa iyadoo lagu salaynayo lakabyada loo qoondeeyey iyo goobta.
datamap-ve-workflow-marker-delete: Tirtir calaamaddan si joogto ah (lagama noqon karo)
datamap-ve-workflow-marker-field-group-d: Calaamad kasta waa inay ka tirsan tahay koox calaamado, taas oo inta badan go'aamisa sida calaamadahooda loogu soo bandhigi doono khariidadda. Kooxaha sidoo kale waxaa loo isticmaalaa habka ugu muhiimsan ee lagu xakameeyo muuqaalka - taas oo daawaduhu ku samayn karo guddiga shaandheeyayaasha.
datamap-ve-workflow-marker-field-categor: Ma ku dari kartid qaybo calaamad haddii aysan jirin qaybo la sameeyey.
datamap-ve-workflow-marker-field-backgro: Tani waxay u baahan tahay wax ka badan hal asal.
datamap-ve-workflow-marker-field-id-desc: Tan si toos ah ayaa loo abuuri doonaa iyadoo lagu salaynayo dejimaha khariidadda.
datamap-ve-group-id-cannot-modify: [PH] Hadda magaca-beddelka kooxaha laguma taageero tifaftiraha muuqaalka

datamap-ve-group-confirm-delete: [PH] Ma hubtaa inaad rabto inaad si joogto ah u tirtirto kooxda calaamadaha $1? Tallaabadan lama soo celin karo.
